notes: The Delhi Metro is clean, cheap and air-conditioned (with a women's carriage). Uber and Ola are safe; bargain with auto-rickshaw drivers. Take the Gatimaan Express to Agra and the Shatabdi to Jaipur.
October to March is the best season (15-25°C). Mornings from November to January bring fog and air pollution. Wear a mask and allow for train delays.
Monument entry costs foreigners 500-600 INR (35 for Indians). An online ASI ticket skips the queue. The Taj is closed on Fridays, the Red Fort on Mondays.
Choose street food that is cooked and hot, and skip ice and raw salads. Drink bottled water. Take probiotics against Delhi belly.
Remove your shoes in temples and mosques, and cover shoulders and knees. Enter Sikh gurdwaras with your head covered; the food is free.
Tip 10%. Bargaining works everywhere: start at a third of the first price.

stops.name: Jama Masjid
stops.tips: India's largest mosque. Buy a minaret ticket for the view. Cover shoulders and knees, and leave your shoes outside.

stops.name: Chandni Chowk
stops.tips: Old Delhi's main market. Take a rickshaw through the narrow lanes and visit the Khari Baoli spice market.

stops.name: Paranthe Wali Gali
stops.tips: A lane of stuffed parathas fried in ghee, open since the 1870s. Expect 3-4 varieties.

stops.name: Red Fort
stops.tips: Shah Jahan's red fortress. UNESCO site, 600 INR for foreigners, closed on Mondays.

stops.name: Karim's Jama Masjid
stops.tips: Mughal cooking since 1913. Order the mutton burra and nihari, on the lane facing the mosque.

backups.name: Al Jawahar Restaurant
backups.tips: Karim's rival across the road. Kebabs and korma.

backups.name: Gurudwara Sis Ganj Sahib
backups.tips: A Sikh temple on Chandni Chowk. Free langar (community meal); enter with your head covered.

stops.name: Humayun's Tomb
stops.tips: The Mughal tomb that preceded the Taj Mahal. Go for the morning light and the gardens.

stops.name: Nizamuddin Dargah
stops.tips: A Sufi shrine. Qawwali music on Thursday evenings, set among narrow lanes.

stops.name: Lodhi Garden
stops.tips: A park among 15th-century tombs. The calmest spot in Delhi.

stops.name: Khan Market
stops.tips: A stylish market. Try the kathi roll at Khan Chacha and browse the bookshops.

stops.name: India Gate
stops.tips: War memorial on Rajpath. In the evening it fills with families and ice cream.

backups.name: Sodabottleopenerwala Khan Market
backups.tips: A Parsi cafe. Try the berry pulao.

backups.name: National Museum Delhi
backups.tips: Harappan finds and Mughal miniatures. An indoor option in the heat.

stops.name: Qutub Minar
stops.tips: A 73 m minaret from the 12th century, with a rust-free iron pillar. Cooler in the morning.

stops.name: Mehrauli Archaeological Park
stops.tips: A free ruins park next to Qutub Minar. Look for Jamali Kamali.

stops.name: Hauz Khas Village
stops.tips: Lakeside madrasa ruins, boutiques and cafes.

stops.name: Hauz Khas Social
stops.tips: A cafe-bar with lake views. Good for lunch.

stops.name: Lotus Temple
stops.tips: The Baha'i lotus-shaped temple. Quiet inside; closed on Mondays.

backups.name: Dilli Haat INA
backups.tips: A market of handicrafts and regional cuisines. An alternative to the temple.

stops.name: Taj Mahal
stops.tips: Take the Gatimaan Express at 08:10 (1.5 hours) or leave by car at 05:00. Sunrise ticket 1,100 + 200 for the mausoleum; closed Fridays; shoe covers are provided.

stops.name: Agra Fort
stops.tips: The fort where Shah Jahan was imprisoned. See the Taj across the river.

stops.name: Pinch of Spice Agra
stops.tips: North Indian cuisine in Agra. Air-conditioned.

stops.name: Itmad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
stops.tips: A small tomb that pioneered marble inlay. No crowds.

stops.name: Mehtab Bagh
stops.tips: A garden on the opposite bank of the river. Sunset view of the Taj; return train at 18:00.

backups.name: Joney's Place Agra
backups.tips: A backpacker classic. Try the lassi.

backups.name: Fatehpur Sikri
backups.tips: An abandoned Mughal capital (40 km). An alternative to Baby Taj.

stops.name: Amber Fort
stops.tips: 4-5 hours from Delhi by train or car (ideal with an overnight stay). Mirror palace on the hilltop; take a jeep instead of an elephant.

stops.name: Hawa Mahal
stops.tips: The facade of the Palace of Winds. Take photos from the cafe opposite.

stops.name: City Palace Jaipur
stops.tips: The Maharaja's palace and museum. The heart of the Pink City.

stops.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar
stops.tips: A sweet shop and restaurant since 1727. Order dal baati and ghewar.

stops.name: Johari Bazaar
stops.tips: A market for jewellery and block-printed fabric. Bargain.

backups.name: Jantar Mantar Jaipur
backups.tips: Giant stone astronomical instruments. An alternative to the palace.

backups.name: Rawat Misthan Bhandar
backups.tips: Pyaz kachori (fried onion-stuffed pastry), Jaipur's street food favourite.

stops.name: Akshardham Temple
stops.tips: A vast modern Hindu temple complex. Phones and cameras are not allowed (leave them in the cloakroom); exhibitions around 250 INR.

stops.name: Connaught Place
stops.tips: A circular market with white colonnades. The centre of Delhi.

stops.name: Saravana Bhavan Connaught Place
stops.tips: South Indian thali and dosa. Air-conditioned.

stops.name: Janpath Market
stops.tips: Tibetan market and textiles. Bargain.

stops.name: Gurudwara Bangla Sahib
stops.tips: A Sikh temple with a golden dome and sacred pool. Visit the langar kitchen.

backups.name: Agrasen ki Baoli
backups.tips: A stepwell. Good photos, near Janpath.

days.theme: Morning market and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Sunder Nursery
stops.tips: A restored Mughal garden next to Humayun's Tomb. Morning walk; organic market on Sundays.

stops.name: Cafe Lota Pragati Maidan
stops.tips: Modern Indian breakfast and lunch in the garden of the crafts museum. A farewell meal.

stops.name: National Crafts Museum
stops.tips: A crafts museum with master artisans' stalls. Good for souvenirs.

stops.name: Delhi Metro Airport Express
stops.tips: 20 minutes from New Delhi station to the airport. Farewell.

backups.name: Andhra Bhavan Canteen
backups.tips: Cheap unlimited thali. A Delhi legend.

backups.name: Purana Qila
backups.tips: The Old Fort and its lake. An alternative to the museum.
